title: Reward Integrity in Adversarial Reinforcement Learning for LLM Guardrail Red-Teaming
abstract: arXiv:2611.26998v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study reward fidelity in an adversarial reinforcement-learning loop for red-teaming financial-services language-model guardrails. Apparent wins can arise when an attack omits prescribed personally identifiable information (PII), or when a reward judge credits a response that did not break the targeted policy. On attacker-generated and public benchmark examples, TypeSafe Jev checks whether the prescribed PII is present. For outcome scoring, we compare the decision models TypeSafe Jev, Laya (pretrained and post-trained), and pretrained CLM-8B with logged Opus 4.8 judgements from a replay corpus. Post-training markedly improves Laya's agreement with the judge. A separate author-reviewed off-target set establishes that Opus can award false wins. The findings motivate specialised decision-model judges for checking prescribed PII in attack inputs and scoring target responses against the intended policy.

translated_title: 面向大语言模型护栏红队测试的对抗性强化学习中的奖励完整性
translated_abstract: 我们研究了用于红队测试金融服务语言模型护栏的对抗性强化学习循环中的奖励保真度问题。当攻击遗漏了规定的个人身份信息（PII），或者当奖励评判者认可了一个并未突破目标策略的响应时，可能会出现表面上的“胜利”。在攻击者生成的示例和公开基准示例上，TypeSafe Jev 用于检查攻击中规定的 PII 是否存在。在结果评分方面，我们将决策模型 TypeSafe Jev、Laya（预训练和后训练版本）以及预训练的 CLM-8B 与来自重放语料库的 Opus 4.8 判定日志进行了比较。后训练显著提高了 Laya 与评判者的一致性。另一个由作者审核的脱靶数据集证实，Opus 可能会授予错误的胜利。这些发现促使人们采用专门的决策模型评判者，用于检查攻击输入中规定的 PII，并根据预期策略对目标响应进行评分。
tldr: 该研究发现在金融服务LLM护栏红队测试的对抗性强化学习循环中，奖励评判可能出现虚假胜利（如攻击遗漏规定PII或评判者误判未违规响应），并通过对比多种决策模型验证了采用专门决策模型作为奖励评判者的必要性。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that reward judges in adversarial RL loops for red-teaming financial-services LLM guardrails can award false wins (e.g., attacks omitting prescribed PII or judges miscrediting non-violating responses), and demonstrates through comparisons across multiple decision models the necessity of using specialised decision-model judges for verifying prescribed PII and scoring target responses against the intended policy.
